scenario.label: hypothetical end-2024 importer invoice, not a real payment or forecast
scenario.markov_quote_schedule: Monday-Friday proxy, holidays and settlement unverified

methods.comparison: same 2024-12-31 rate, USD invoice, 90-day due date, LKR budget, 8 seeds and 10000 paths per seed; GBM cases reuse the same normal draws per seed
methods.holdout: 2025-2026 excluded from every fit and case definition
methods.volatility_stress: multiply baseline sigma with common alpha; assumed shock, not data filtering
methods.time_alternative: training quote returns treated as equal sessions, sample SD annualized by sqrt(252), 64 assumed future quotes imply T=64/252; not mixed with H/365
methods.uncertainty: pooled mean-cost MC interval and per-seed sample SD/min/max of VaR/ES; conditional on fitted parameters

convergence.method: independent replicate seeds; nested prefixes within each seed; RMSE against analytical GBM mean

limitations: Cases were predeclared from training-data inspection; they are not unbiased model selection or predictive validation.
The 2022-excluded fit uses two disjoint return blocks without fabricating a bridging return.
The 252-session alternative uses a weekday proxy and ignores holidays/settlement.
Monte Carlo error excludes calibration-window and structural-model uncertainty.
